title: AcknowledgesReachChangeCommitment
description: Payload shape for a Mishpat::Commitment entry with action='acknowledges-reach-change'. The operator-steward's signed acknowledgement that a republished EprHead's new reach value is intentional, releasing the doorway projection from the soft-warn pause. Source of truth: Holochain DHT (Mishpat zome, existing Commitment entry type with new action discriminator). Canon: genesis/docs/architecture/stewardship-over-sovereignty.md §6 rule 3. Spec: Z.D §3 soft-warn ceremony.

acknowledger.description: CID or agent identifier of the operator-steward acknowledging. Mishpat coordinator validates that the acknowledger holds the project-epr Commitment for the target EPR.

target_epr_cid.description: CID of the new EprHead that triggered the soft-warn pause.

new_reach.description: The reach value the acknowledger is consenting to. Must match the new EprHead's envelope.reach exactly — Mishpat coordinator rejects mismatches as evidence of confusion or tampering.

signed_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the acknowledgement was signed.
